observed_value: issuer_name values include raw section, industry, investment, acquisition date, reference rate, and interest-rate text instead of only the issuer/company name
anchor_value: raw SOI rows separate Company from Investment, Initial Acquisition Date, Reference Rate and Spread, and Interest Rate columns

findings.detail: issuer_name is populated from concatenated SOI wrapper/row text instead of the clean Company cell; Passport Labs continuation investment terms were included in issuer_name.
equity rows show the same contamination: clean company Dye & Durham, Ltd. is separate from Common Shares and acquisition-date fields that leaked into issuer_name.

rationale: C206 is a real issuer_name parse-leak error. The raw source SOI has separate Company and Investment/terms columns, while the flagged extracted issuer_name values concatenate section labels, company, instrument, acquisition date, reference spread, and interest-rate text. The cited Passport Labs, Dye & Durham, and American Achievement source rows demonstrate that the correct issuer/company field is only the company cell, not the full concatenated row text.
